claims.claim: CLD with RL reward guidance reaches a failure rate of 0.226 on the no-collision task, lower than the baselines in Table I.
claims.condition: nuScenes, closed-loop simulation 20 s at 2 Hz re-planning, CLD (w/RL) with reward -1 for collision; failure = scenario where ego collides or leaves drivable area
claims.comparison: baselines SimNet, TrafficSim, BITS, CTG (with/without opt variants) from Table I
claims.quote:
no-collision task, our method achieves a failure rate of
0.226 — significantly lower than those of the baselines

claims.claim: Removing reward guidance (CLD w/o RL) raises the no-collision failure rate to 0.483.
claims.condition: nuScenes, closed-loop 20 s at 2 Hz, CLD without RL reward guidance
claims.quote:
the failure rates increase to 0.483 and 0.450,
respectively

claims.comparison: baselines in Table I; CLD (w/o RL) at 0.450
